why: v3 shortens the target length from 30-45 s (max 50) to 28-35 s (max 40). Average watch time is the same whatever the length (median 6.49 s on the 14 reels of 35 s or less, 6.29 s on the 5 reels of 35-45 s), so extra seconds only lower the watch ratio: median 0.210 at 35 s or less against 0.175 at 35-45 s and 0.071 above 45 s. Skip rate is also better on short reels (57.7% against 60.9%). barcelona-atletico-madrid-2026-11-08 was planned at about 30 s, came out at 41.7 s inside the old limit and got a 0.146 ratio; aston-villa-manchester-united-2026-11-08 at 34.7 s got 0.220.
owner_note: The performance-analyst may change anything in 'tunable' (one change per version, see .claude/agents/performance-analyst.md). Nothing in 'locked' may change without the user.

hook.rule: Say the surprising number or verdict first, then explain. No build-up before the payoff.
hook.first_frame: The hook card shows the payoff in big text from frame 0 (it is the cover).

structure.note: payoff number in the first line
2-3 numbers that back the hook, straight after it
the single best of: tactical change, trend storyline, banter. Pick one; don't do all three
best OR worst player, whichever is the stronger story (worst + anger if anger_worthy)
angry/furious rant or laughing banter, 1-2 short lines

caption.first_line: the hook in 8 words or fewer

posting.aim: post within 24 h of full time
posting.note: post delay itself lives in config/teams.json (post_delay_minutes)

angle.rule: Answer the question fans are already arguing about with our numbers (trends.json reel_angle).

locked.facts: Every number on screen or spoken comes from the match data, trends.json or data/form with a source.
locked.banter: Red lines in config/teams.json; favourites Man United, Real Madrid, PSG, Bayern; no banter when a favourite loses.
locked.presenter: Scout the gorilla, emotions from presenter/presenter.js.
locked.voice: IndexTTS 2.5 with the Echo reference voice, no pitch effects, emotion settings in config/teams.json voice.indextts (version B, user-approved).
locked.league_colours: EPL purple, La Liga blue, Bundesliga orange (config/teams.json league_themes).
locked.account: Instagram @thescoutbrief only, reviewer PASS before posting, approval mode from config/teams.json.

history.summary: 35-65 s, 7-10 beats, build-up hook, every section in every reel
payoff in 3 s, 30-45 s, 5-8 beats, one story per reel
history.judged: 2026-11-10, after 19 v2 reels: kept. Against the 3 v1/pre-v1 reels, the median skip rate went from 73.9% to 59.1%, avg watch from 4.3 s to 6.43 s and the watch ratio from 0.071 to 0.188. Shares+saves per 1k reach: 0.0 median in both, with 3 v2 reels above 0 (5.2-6.1).
